structuralFindings: Structurally identical to the Rack document — same 5 seasonal columns, same room categories, same seaview surcharge concept, same policies (cancellation, check-in/out, longstay/group discount, honeymoon package, children policy shape).

NET figures are consistently lower than Rack, by roughly 28-35% depending on room/season — not a single flat percentage across every cell (e.g. Standard DBL main season: Rack $100 -> NET $72, a 28% cut; Suite Seaview SGL festive: Rack $672 -> NET $449, a 33% cut). Unlike Soroi's STO-tier finding (exactly Rack x (1-discount%) on every cell), this NET rate is NOT a clean single-percentage discount off Rack — flag this if anyone tries to back-calculate one tier from the other.
Bed & Breakfast reduction on HB rate here is -$10 (vs -$15 on the Rack tier) — a different reduction amount at NET than at Rack, not just a scaled-down version.
Transport figures also differ from Rack: SGR-Station Transfer $18 (vs $28 Rack), Airport Transfer $15 (vs $23 Rack).
Children policy flat rate for 3-12yrs sharing with adult is the SAME $26 as the Rack tier (not discounted at NET) — worth noting since everything else is discounted.
